**Title:** (new) → Fix incomplete report downloads, duplicate emails, and incorrect email dates

## Proposed body

### Context

A customer support review triggered this request. Customers can currently download reports or receive them by email.

### Problem

The first download from a report email is empty, forcing the recipient to retry.

Example — first emailed download: A 12-row report initially downloads as zero rows, but retrying later returns all 12 rows.

Downloads omit the final row, leaving recipients with incomplete totals.

Example — final download row: A four-row report downloads as three rows even though the fourth row appears on screen.

A single delivery request sends duplicate emails, making recipients check whether the reports differ.

Example — duplicate delivery email: One delivery request sends two emails containing the same file.

The email subject names yesterday’s report, causing recipients to misfile today’s work.

Example — report subject date: An October 21 request produces an October 20 subject even though the attached file is for October 21.

### Idea

The reporter proposes fixing report delivery.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Given a report containing 12 rows, when the recipient first downloads it from its delivery email, the downloaded report contains all 12 rows without a retry.
- [ ] Given a report with four rows visible on screen, when the recipient downloads it, the downloaded report contains all four rows.
- [ ] Given one report delivery request, when the report is emailed, the recipient receives exactly one email for that request.
- [ ] Given a request for an October 21 report, when its delivery email is sent, the subject names October 21.
